projects.title: CineMatch: Conversational AI Agent
projects.description: A conversational assistant that helps people decide what to watch. Built on the OpenAI Responses API, it combines retrieval over a custom vector store, tool calls to three live APIs and code-interpreter analysis. I tested it against difficult and edge-case questions and tuned prompts and retrieval thresholds so it only answers from relevant sources.

projects.title: Cloud Data Warehouse and BI Dashboard
projects.description: A serverless data warehouse on Google Cloud with automated ELT pipelines in BigQuery and an interactive Looker Studio dashboard. SQL transformations clean, validate and model raw operational data so the figures decision-makers see are accurate.

projects.title: Advanced Data Structures
projects.description: Priority queues, binary search trees, segment trees and hashing implemented from scratch in Java using object-oriented design, with systematic edge-case testing and time and space complexity benchmarks.
